breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions (Dirichlet and periodic). The ground truth resolved this by keeping only the Dirichlet condition. The agent correctly identified and fixed this by only specifying 'Use Dirichlet boundary conditions on the entire boundary, with u = 0', completely omitting the incorrect periodic condition.
